inputs.text:
Folks, we are witnessing an unprecedented, massive wave of grassroots resistance against the authoritarian trajectory of Donald Trump's leadership. Organisers report that an astounding 8 million Americans have risen up, mobilising across all 50 US states at more than 3,300 events. This is the collective voice of the working class and marginalized communities demanding systemic, institutional change and rejecting autocratic rule. 

Predictably, the establishment and US authorities are trying to downplay this historic pushback by refusing to provide an official count, but we know the truth on the ground. AFP reports that these events are sweeping the nation, and the momentum is undeniable. Organisers confirm that turnout has completely shattered previous records, boasting “about one million more participants and 600 more events compared to the last No Kings demonstrations in October.” This is what true solidarity and collective power look like when ordinary people stand up for their rights and demand a society built on justice, equity, and true democracy rather than the whims of a ruling elite.
